text:
maya: Heads-up — we need to lock dependencies for the 'Adaptive Capacity Pilot' for a customer demo. Goal: stable p95 latency and predictable cost at ~8k rps. Who can own which pieces?

ezra: I'm in. Runtime needs to surface autoscale knobs and a canary plan. @sam-runtime @leah-infra can you confirm constraints?

sam-runtime: Can do. Quick q: target burst GPUs and prewarm approach? Also do we need KV cache persistence across canary->prod?

leah-infra: We can reserve 2x A100-equivalent GPUs per region for the demo window, but that requires VPC peering and IAM ACLs updated. ETA to provision: ~36h after ticket.

toni-security: From security side — we need a short threat-model and data flow doc. If any customer payloads contain PII we require TLS+KMS and minimum logging retention. Also legal sign-off may be needed for the demo environment.

maya: Timeline: demo in ~72h. Action items: runtime produce canary rollout + prewarm recipe, infra file capacity ticket and prewarm ops, security produce checklist for demo sign-off.

ezra: Draft canary snippet (proposal):
```
canary:
  percent: 5
  health_check_interval_s: 15
  max_tokens: 2048
  batch_window_ms: 20
  fallback_model: rwd-lite-v1
```

sam-runtime: I prefer starting at 5% then jump to 50% after 10m steady health metrics, enable prefix cache TTL=2h and KV sticky sessions for the demo. Also add a kill-switch route.

leah-infra: Filed CAP-3287 for reserved capacity + VPC peering. Link: https://phabricator/internal/CAP-3287 — assigned to infra oncall, ETA 36h.

toni-security: Checklist I will send: KMS access, retention window, data redaction rules, logging endpoints. Need legal + compliance sign-off by demo T-24h.

deploy-bot: Staging cluster autoscale: prewarm +2 nodes scheduled for demo window. Ticket CAP-3287 referenced. :rocket: 

maya: Thanks — can we do a 30m sync tomorrow morning to confirm all sign-offs? If any blocker, escalate to exec immediately.

ezra: 10:30 PT tomorrow works for me.

sam-runtime: I'll bring canary health dashboards and a rollback playbook.

maya: Awesome. I'll collect all items in the initiative card and share before the sync. :thumbsup:
